title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry I didn’t get back to yesterday, phone was blowing up
Thank you. It was past due, I’ve given them so much rope
No problem...I hope the attention was mostly positive.
Some of these fans are blind as hell
You can only lead a horse to water, or something like that
I was actually expecting most of the fans to like it. I was more concerned that someone from the organization would give you shit about it
Nothing yet but I’ll be there today
